<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def barstate(f):
    s={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']
        if n['pixels']<=5 and b and 43<=b[0][0]<=47:
            s[b[0][1]]=1 if n['color']=='B' else 0
    return tuple(s[c] for c in (21,26,31,36,41))
def objs(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']
        if n['color']=='Y' and n['pixels']>10:
            out.append(('Y',min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b),n['pixels']))
        elif n['color']=='b' and n['pixels']>10 and b and b[0][0]>10:
            out.append(('b',min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b),n['pixels']))
    return sorted(out)
def cd(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']
        if n['color']=='b' and b and b[0][0]<=2:
            return n['pixels']
    return None
base=objs(current_frame)
print("start bar:",barstate(current_frame),"cd:",cd(current_frame))
cols={0:21,1:26,2:31,3:36,4:41}
def set_state(target):
    cur=barstate(current_frame)
    for i in range(5):
        if cur[i]!=target[i]:
            action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':44,'col':cols[i]}])
            cur=barstate(current_frame)
    return cur
def check(tag):
    r=last_action_result
    moved=objs(current_frame)!=base
    done=r.get('level_completed') or r.get('game_over') or r.get('done')
    print(tag,"bar=",barstate(current_frame),"cd=",cd(current_frame),"moved=",moved,"done=",done)
    return done or moved
# 00010 (bump row, bar0=top)
set_state((0,0,0,1,0)); check("00010")
# 01000 (bump row, bar0=bottom)
set_state((0,1,0,0,0)); check("01000")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def barstate(f):
    s={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:

def objs(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']
        if n['color']=='Y' and n['pixels']>10:
            out.append(('Y',min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b),n['pixels']))

            out.append(('b',min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b),n['pixels']))
